title: Rolling SPY Puts 734 Times
text: We looked at 19 and a half years. It was 734 rolls, meaning we maintain these perpetual hedges with nine different designs. I gave the strategy as many favorable choices as I could, meaning I priced everything at the mid, which is not always realistic, especially at size. So, I also show you what the cost would be if you transacted at the offer. And I looked at different common targets for puts in terms of way to think about their DTE, how long you're holding them for, or what the term is. And then also with what I refer to as their deductible, and I'll show you what that means.
